set -u
evidence=/var/folders/vm/tn1q05bx5hxffc9f6v6p_1pc0000gn/T/symphony-1084.rtphexyk
docker image inspect symphony-1084-audit --format '{{.Id}}' > "$evidence/linux/image-id.txt"
docker run -d --name symphony-1084-series -v "$evidence:/evidence" -w /evidence/frozen/packages/cli symphony-1084-audit sleep infinity > "$evidence/linux/container-id.txt"
for round in 1 2 3; do
  for kind in comparison control; do
    label="$kind-$round"
    if [ "$kind" = comparison ]; then
      archive=/evidence/baseline.tgz
      source=/evidence/baseline-source
      sha=95ec5577cd1fe057b35f35770d1d4e359d2087b0
    else
      archive=/evidence/candidate.tgz
      source=/evidence/frozen
      sha=7df7f69765979848e76f0fc42b36f3cab9da64e6
    fi
    bash /var/folders/vm/tn1q05bx5hxffc9f6v6p_1pc0000gn/T/symphony-1084.9NITDM/host.sh > "$evidence/linux/$label-before-host.txt" 2>&1
    docker exec symphony-1084-series sh -c 'date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; uname -a; /usr/local/bin/node --version; uptime; top -b -n 2 -d 1 | head -30; free -m; vmstat; cat /proc/pressure/memory; echo "Container power/thermal metrics unavailable; see physical host snapshots"' > "$evidence/linux/$label-before-container.txt" 2>&1
    date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$evidence/linux/$label-start.txt"
    docker exec symphony-1084-series /usr/local/bin/node scripts/otlp-package-audit.mjs "$archive" "/evidence/linux/$label.json" "$source" "$sha" --production-cli > "$evidence/linux/$label.log" 2>&1
    code=$?
    printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$evidence/linux/$label-exit.txt"
    date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$evidence/linux/$label-end.txt"
    docker exec symphony-1084-series sh -c 'date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; uname -a; /usr/local/bin/node --version; uptime; top -b -n 2 -d 1 | head -30; free -m; vmstat; cat /proc/pressure/memory; echo "Container power/thermal metrics unavailable; see physical host snapshots"' > "$evidence/linux/$label-after-container.txt" 2>&1
    bash /var/folders/vm/tn1q05bx5hxffc9f6v6p_1pc0000gn/T/symphony-1084.9NITDM/host.sh > "$evidence/linux/$label-after-host.txt" 2>&1
    printf '%s exit=%s\n' "$label" "$code"
  done
done
docker rm -f symphony-1084-series
